summary_en: The study tests computer guidance software used during microwave ablation, a procedure that heats and destroys liver tumors, in adults with localized hepatocellular carcinoma (liver cancer). The ablation is done with CT guidance while the software shows which part of the tumor has been treated, and follow-up is at one month and then every 3 months with blood tests and contrast-enhanced CT or MRI. The study measures how often a tumor is incompletely treated, local tumor recurrence at 2 years, and changes in medical problems after the procedure.
summary_es: El estudio prueba un software de guía por computadora que se usa durante la ablación por microondas, un procedimiento que calienta y destruye tumores del hígado, en adultos con carcinoma hepatocelular (cáncer de hígado) localizado. La ablación se realiza con guía de tomografía computarizada mientras el software muestra qué parte del tumor ya fue tratada, y el seguimiento es al mes y luego cada 3 meses, con análisis de sangre y estudios de TC con contraste o resonancia magnética. El estudio mide con qué frecuencia un tumor queda tratado de forma incompleta, la recurrencia local del tumor a los 2 años y los cambios en problemas médicos después del procedimiento.
who_for: Adults 18 years or older with a life expectancy of at least 1 year
Hepatocellular carcinoma confirmed by imaging, biopsy, or cirrhosis with high AFP
Localized liver tumors: up to 5 lesions, at least one 2–5 cm, none over 5 cm, judged feasible for ablation
Performance status 0–2 (ECOG), adequate platelets and INR, and able to have contrast CT or MRI
Willing and able to give informed consent
not_for: Prior ablation, TACE, SBRT, or resection of the target lesion or a lesion within 1 cm of it
More than 5 liver lesions, or any lesion that cannot be completely ablated
Uncontrolled liver decompensation, such as persistent encephalopathy
Uncorrectable coagulopathy, contraindication to contrast imaging, active systemic infection, or pregnancy
Unable to follow the imaging schedule
